name: Koe de Oshigoto!
source:
The bonus included in the first edition of volume 10 is a completely original adventure game depicting the appearance of Kanna and the others creating the play-in-the-work game "Koe no Oshigoto!".

[Translated from [url=https://www.wani.co.jp/event.php?id=3961]wani books site[/url]]
translation:
第10卷初版中的特典是一款完全原创的冒险游戏，描绘了神无等人创作的游戏“Koe no Oshigoto！”的样子。

[译自[url=https://www.wani.co.jp/event.php?id=3961]wani图书网站[/url]]
